scenes.subtext: The system has never heard of him.
scenes.narration: I typed the twelfth name into the access system. It has never heard of him. No badge, no number, no start date.

scenes.narration: So I pulled the door log instead. Every night this month it records twelve entries at the staff door. Eleven badges exist.

scenes.subtext: The list closes over the gap.
scenes.narration: The badge numbers run in order. One is missing from the middle, and the list closes over the gap without leaving a space.

scenes.subtext: He said it like a job title.
scenes.narration: I asked the officer on the desk who the twelfth is. He did not look up from the monitor. He said, that is the one who locks up.

scenes.narration: Nobody locks up. There is no key on the board for the staff door and there never has been. It is always already locked when we leave.

scenes.subtext: He does not need a badge.
scenes.narration: The log shows his entry every night at ten past eleven. The reader has no record of a card. He does not need one. He is already inside.
